game_title: Roll Call Enumerate – Hollow Log Trail Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail, a trail through hollow logs: the wood elf archer must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Roll Call Enumerate: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call.
theme: Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail: a trail through hollow logs
core_gameplay_loop: In Hollow Log Trail, repeat each round: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the roll_call value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the mushroom ring using at most 20 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The mushroom ring reached with actions_used <= 20.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 20 before the mushroom ring is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Roll Call Enumerate
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cursed treants in Hollow Log Trail.
